resolutions.researcher_notes: IMPORTANT NUANCE, flagged rather than silently resolved: the SAME current PNGRB report (May 2026) carries TWO different capacity figures for this GAIL 'Integrated HVJ' system (which subsumes P3299/GREP-II) in two different tables. (1) The main 'Physical progress report' table (printed p.2) lists Authorised Capacity = Design/Determined Capacity = 111.3 MMSCMD for entity GAIL, 'Hazira-Vijaipur-Jagdishpur-GREP-Dahej-Vijaipur HVJ/VDPL Dadri' -- this is the figure the register-crosswalk's VALIDITY flag on this same row compared the sheet's 107.00 against, and it also matches the arithmetic in GAIL's own 2018 letter (HVJ 33.4 + DVPL-I 23.9 + Upgradation Phase-I+II combined 54.0 = 111.3 MMSCMD). (2) A SEPARATE table (printed p.6, 'NGPL UNDER REGULATION 17 (MMSCMD)', row 2) lists the same entity/pipeline ('GAIL, Integrated HVJ', same 6,169/6,732 km) with Design/Determined Capacity = 107.0 MMSCMD -- an EXACT match to the sheet's recorded Capacity=107.00 MMSCMD. So the recorded value IS directly, verbatim supported by a legitimate table in the current regulatory filing, just not the table the earlier VALIDITY check compared against; both figures are PNGRB-origin though (single document, single regulator), so independent=false and tier=medium rather than high. Per the standing rule that Capacity here is a shared 5-row integrated-network total (not GREP-II's own throughput -- see the already-staged VALIDITY notes on this row and sibling P3298), citing this and NOT overriding the value; the 107.0-vs-111.3 discrepancy between PNGRB's own two tables is a genuine open question worth a human look but is not, on this evidence, a case of the sheet being simply wrong -- it may instead be tracking the Reg.17 utilisation-reporting figure rather than the physical-progress authorised-capacity figure. Recommend Update review the two PNGRB tables side by side before touching the value.
